title: AAA Basics
description: Enable AAA and require local username login on console and VTY lines.
scenario: Enable AAA and require local username login on console and VTY lines.

concepts.title: What is AAA?
concepts.body: Authentication proves who you are, Authorization controls what you can do, Accounting records what you did.

concepts.title: Local vs Server-Based
concepts.body: Local AAA uses the username database stored on the device itself. Larger networks centralize it with RADIUS or TACACS+ servers.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# aaa new-model
SW1(config)# username admin password cisco123

concepts.title: login local
concepts.body: Applying "login local" on console/VTY lines forces users to authenticate against the local username database instead of a simple line password.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# line console 0
SW1(config-line)# login local
SW1(config)# line vty 0 4
SW1(config-line)# login local
